title: CREEPER STAFF
description: Master moderation with stealth vanish, live inspection, and instant Discord alerts
body:
# 🟢 CreeperStaff
## Modern Moderation Suite for Minecraft Servers

CreeperStaff is a lightweight, modern, and powerful moderation plugin designed for server owners who want speed, security, and complete control. Built with a clean interface and performance-focused systems, CreeperStaff delivers a professional staff management experience without unnecessary complexity.

---

## 🚀 Main Features

### 🕵️ Advanced Vanish System
- Multiple vanish modes  
- Hidden from players & tab list  
- Staff-only visibility support  

### 📂 Live Player Inspection
- Inspect player inventories in real time  
- Ender Chest viewing support  
- Fast moderation tools for investigations  

### ❄️ Freeze System
- Instantly freeze suspicious players  
- Useful for investigations & rule enforcement  
- Simple and reliable moderation workflow  

### 📡 Discord Webhook Support
- Built-in `/report` system  
- Sends alerts directly to Discord  
- Real-time moderation notifications  

### 💬 Private Staff Chat
- Secure communication channel for staff  
- Quick access with `/staffchat` and `/sc`  
- Hidden from regular players  

### 🛠️ Staff Management
- In-game staff management tools  
- LuckPerms integration support  
- Simple rank & permission handling  

---

## 🎮 Main Commands

| Command | Alias | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `/creepers help` | `/creepers` | View help menu |
| `/staffchat` | `/sc` | Private staff communication |
| `/vanish` | `/v` | Toggle vanish |
| `/freeze` | - | Freeze a player |
| `/report` | - | Send Discord report |
| `/staff` | - | Manage staff system |

---

## 💎 Why CreeperStaff?

### ⚡ Performance Focused
Optimized systems designed to keep moderation smooth without impacting server performance.

### 👻 Secure Moderation
Commands remain hidden from regular player tab completion for improved security.

### 🖥️ Clean & Professional
Simple interface and modern systems built for real server environments.

### 🔮 Multi-Platform Support
Supports:
- Paper
- Purpur
- Spigot

Compatible with:
### Minecraft `1.21 → 1.26.2`

---

## ⚠️ Dependency Note
- LuckPerms is required for `/staff` management features.

---
